hebrewText: יַסְּרֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל בְּ/אַפְּ/ךָ֖ פֶּן תַּמְעִטֵֽ/נִי

tokens.bdb: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
tokens.kjv: bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
tokens.kjv: also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely, of a surety, truly, verily, [phrase] wherefore, yet (but).

tokens.bdb: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law, individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice, including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
tokens.kjv: [phrase] adversary, ceremony, charge, [idiom] crime, custom, desert, determination, discretion, disposing, due, fashion, form, to be judged, judgment, just(-ice, -ly), (manner of) law(-ful), manner, measure, (due) order, ordinance, right, sentence, usest, [idiom] worthy, [phrase] wrong.

tokens.bdb: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
tokens.kjv: nay, neither, [phrase] never, no, nor, not, nothing (worth), rather than.

tokens.bdb: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
tokens.kjv: anger(-gry), [phrase] before, countenance, face, [phrase] forebearing, forehead, [phrase] (long-) suffering, nose, nostril, snout, [idiom] worthy, wrath.

tokens.bdb: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
properly, to pare off, i.e. lessen; intransitively, to be (or causatively, to make) small or few (or figuratively, ineffective)
tokens.kjv: suffer to decrease, diminish, (be, [idiom] borrow a, give, make) few (in number, -ness), gather least (little), be (seem) little, ([idiom] give the) less, be minished, bring to nothing.
